status: Independent pre-run design and feasibility review; full-scale FWI acceptance pending
reviewer: marmousi_review, independent source/array reviewer; no production solver or GPU launched
rule: For each epoch, all declared independent shots use one actual physical model fingerprint, shot losses and raw gradients reduce with identical weights/normalizer, then at most one accepted update.
objective_contract: Declare objective/filter/window/observed-RMS scales and hash before optimization. Divide Nt*Nr once per-shot and number of shots once for mean; do not average unequal batch means without actual batch-size weights.
Apply regularization once after the global reduction. A changing frequency stage defines a new objective and resets L-BFGS history.

Each Armijo trial is a complete all-shot evaluation at one candidate fingerprint; use g_dot_actual_coordinate_step after any projection or cap. Rejecting/aborting a candidate does not update the accepted model.
coordinate_and_material_contract: Declare q-to-Vp, fixed-water/buffer P, and exact static transpose once; changing q must change actual Vp SHA at noninitial points while Vs/rho SHA remain identical.
Require finite rho>0, Vs>=0, positive 3-D bulk rho*(Vp^2-4Vs^2/3); allow physically admissible negative lambda explicitly. Enforce actual native CFL/dispersion gates for all evaluated models.

Training containers omit unknown true Vp. It may only create fixed target data and separate posthoc evaluation; no true-Vp dependent bound, step, line search acceptance, iteration count or stop decision.
required_qualification: CPU three-source noninitial q test: serial vs batched and uneven final batch, physical and coordinate AD/native gradients, full objective directional checks at multiple h, actual field/target hashes.

One actual nine-shot epoch with per-source geometry/target/loss/g/model ledger and one accepted update; all edge and central sources receive a finite/late-time quality screen, not only central source.

Three to five complete epochs using the same source set to measure accepted loss reduction, projected step norm, line-search cost, secants and checkpoint restoration before committing the remaining predeclared budget.
At a later noninitial accepted model and each new stage, repeat a meaningful full-objective directional or AD reference check without using unknown true Vp to choose directions.
predeclared_stopping: Maximum accepted epochs and bounded line-search trials; resource/time cap reports explicit incomplete/interrupted status.
Data-only stage loss change and projected-gradient/actual-update stagnation criteria with scale-aware tolerances; no default absolute gtol unsuitable for tiny raw native SI-unit objectives.
Finite data/material and quality checks can stop an invalid experiment; posthoc truth error never controls training or stop.
scientific_scope: More epochs and independent sources improve optimization/illumination opportunities but cannot guarantee recovery of missing bandwidth or every thin layer.
A finite correct derivative at a fixed point is not reconstruction quality or global optimization convergence.
These two implementations have different mesh, frequency, acquisition, boundary and compute architectures; extrapolations are within-case planning estimates, not a performance ranking.

generic_skill_executable_audit.status: PASS for actual generic C++ five-shot CPU exercise, including full-objective FD and real rejected line-search trials

cost_extrapolation.basis: Measured 2-MPI rank 192x84,2Hz,6s Vp-only case; excludes entire finite-difference validation runtime.
cost_extrapolation.sequential_fullshot_scratch_policy: One shot forward immediately followed by its adjoint, retaining the same immutable epoch model. Sum its gradient then release history before the next shot: peak history approximately one shot, not nine.
cost_extrapolation.bounded_alternative: Keep all nine independent sources each epoch; qualify coarse low-frequency stages, then explicitly budget a smaller number of fine 2Hz epochs. Do not describe this as 100 fine-grid epochs.
cost_extrapolation.not_included: Target generation, preparation, qualification, line-search forwards, model-dot checks, checkpoints, resource queueing and later-model variation.

pinned_example_configuration.scope: Water-free 45m grid, joint Vp/Vs/rho, displacement vx/vz, 5Hz source
pinned_example_configuration.loss: Global correlation with per-trace max normalization and gradient maximum normalization, distinct from new fixed-observed-RMS L2

pinned_vendor_context.usable_orchestration_pattern: ElasticFWI.forward zero_grad before all source batches and optimizer.step after the entire batch loop. Each shot batch is at the same model.
do_not_copy: Example bound arrays use true model minima/maxima: incompatible with the current unknown true-Vp training rule.
Nonzero regularizer is added once per batch in vendor loop; new contract requires applying R once after all source reductions. The referenced example sets zero regularization weights.
5Hz/300 epochs and 40 sources in a different experiment are not evidence that the present 9-source water/PML experiment recovers every thin layer.

sanitization.scope: Public path identifiers only; all original numeric values, solver/source SHA values, outcomes and limitations preserved.
